hypothesis: Inserting crop-to-nonzero before the 128^3 resize raises validation DSC relative to the whole-head-resize arm, because it roughly doubles the lesion's voxel count on the model grid and stops ~52% of the input (and ~267 of the image encoder's 512 tokens) from covering background.

prior_evidence.probe: same whole-head-trained weights, geometry swapped at inference only
prior_evidence.caveat: the probe fed brain-cropped input to whole-head-trained weights, so its delta is a LOWER bound on the trained effect, not an estimate

held_identical_to_the_reference_arm: AdamW, encoder LR 1e-4 / head LR 1e-5, weight decay 0.1
per-GPU batch 2 x 2 GPUs x 3 accumulation steps = effective batch 12
200 epoch cap, min 40 epochs before stop, patience 40
bf16, explicit gradient all-reduce across 2 ranks
affine + elastic + noise augmentation, train split only
3 accumulated corrective clicks with the recurrent low-res mask, raw logit > 0
N4 bias field correction, shrink 2, 4x50 iterations, nonzero mask
the frozen 972 train / 108 validation subject-clean split
single_factor.why_this_is_attributable: Unlike the reference arm -- which moved unfreeze policy, LR direction, N4, epochs, batch and DDP together and was therefore explicitly marked non-attributable -- this arm changes exactly one factor, so its delta against the reference arm IS a controlled contrast.

geometry.name: braincrop_resize
geometry.description: crop to the bounding box of nonzero voxels, then resize that box to 128^3. Does NOT use the label: the box comes from image intensity only, so localization is not oracle.
geometry.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score before resize; unchanged by the crop because the crop removes only zero voxels

selection_rule.rule: strict argmax over completed epochs; ties keep the earlier epoch

test_protocol.precondition: a frozen configuration record must be on disk BEFORE any test NIfTI is opened
test_protocol.note: This will be the 6th consumption of the 270-case test by this project. The number is an internal held-out readout, not clean external validation.

prohibitions_still_in_force: no threshold / TTA / morphology / connected-component / postprocessing search
no mid-run change to LR, unfreeze depth, initialization, augmentation, epoch cap or patience
no use of any test result to select an epoch, a configuration or a next arm
no rewriting of a binding hash to make a check pass; fail closed instead

known_defects_carried_over_deliberately.defect: patience 40 is smaller than the first LR milestone 120, so MultiStepLR can never fire before early stopping
known_defects_carried_over_deliberately.why_kept: changing it would break the single-factor contrast with the reference arm, which ran under the same defect and stopped at epoch 64

known_defects_carried_over_deliberately.defect: the trainer constructs T1ceWtPreprocessConfig(spatial_preprocessing='whole_resize') while the cache is braincrop_resize
known_defects_carried_over_deliberately.impact: none on behaviour: that object is consumed only by build_training_augmentation, which is geometry-independent. The geometry recorded in train_config.json is copied from the cache index and is therefore correct.
known_defects_carried_over_deliberately.why_kept: the alternative is editing a trainer whose SHA is recorded in the completed arm's train_config.json

prediction_registered_before_the_run.primary: validation scan-macro DSC at click 3 exceeds the reference arm's 0.5633
prediction_registered_before_the_run.falsifiable: if validation DSC does not exceed 0.5633, the crop is recorded as not helping when trained with, and no test run is taken
prediction_registered_before_the_run.agent_prior: The agent previously predicted the inference-only probe would LOWER the score and was refuted by measurement. That miss is recorded so this prediction is read with appropriate scepticism.
